# v7.3 fixtures

Written by MATLAB and vendored from [MAT.jl](https://github.com/JuliaIO/MAT.jl)
(`test/v7.3/`, MIT licence), retrieved 2026-09-08.

They are genuine MATLAB output, not synthesized: superblock version 0, version-1 object
headers, symbol-table groups, and a 512-byte user block holding the MATLAB banner. Datasets
are compact except `partial.mat`, which is chunked and deflated.
